title: How to convert Yes/No (or TRUE/FALSE) to 1 and 0
task: Turn text answers into numbers you can sum, average, or score.

excel.note: For real TRUE/FALSE values, just multiply by 1: =A2*1, or use --A2.

explanation: IF maps the text to numbers: "Yes" becomes 1, anything else 0 — now the column sums (a count of Yeses) and averages (a proportion). The comparison is case-insensitive, so "yes" and "YES" both match. If your cells hold actual boolean TRUE/FALSE rather than text, skip the IF: TRUE already equals 1 in arithmetic, so =A2*1 or the double-negative =--A2 converts them directly. To score more than two answers, nest IF or use a lookup table (Yes=2, Maybe=1, No=0).
